slides.text: In the obsidian city of Oakhaven, magic isn't learned; it's bought with memories. A simple fire spell costs a childhood birthday. Healing a wound costs a first kiss. I was the realm’s greatest archmage, feared and revered, having defeated the Shadow King single-handedly. But my absolute power came at an absolute price. I possessed a grimoire of world-shattering spells, but my own mind was a terrifying, hollow cavern. I had saved the world, but forgot why it mattered.

One evening, a young man with familiar emerald eyes approached my throne. He didn't ask for gold or protection. He handed me a wooden carved sparrow. 'You made this for me,' he said gently, 'before you went to war.' I stared at the bird, desperate to feel a flicker of recognition. Nothing. My heart was a stone. 'Who are you?' I whispered, terrified of the answer, staring at a stranger who looked so desperately at me.

He smiled, though tears tracked through the soot on his cheeks. 'I am your son, Father. And I have come to buy your memories back.' He drew a glowing silver dagger, the rare artifact capable of reversing the arcane trade. 'It will cost all of my magic,' he said, 'but you will finally remember my mother's face.' Before I could cast a shield to stop him, he plunged the glowing blade deep into his own chest.
